verdict: ARMS NOT COMMENSURABLE FROM STORED ARTIFACTS
reading: The routing arm is scored in wrong-model rate and closes 27.1% of its recoverable gap (0.675 -> 0.542 against a 0.183 floor) for $2.39. The measurement arm is scored in judge accuracy and improves 0.404 -> 0.370 by 2,500 labels. R1 stated that judge-accuracy units do not count, and he is right: putting the measurement arm into wrong-model-rate units requires a mapping from evaluator error to identification error that the stored artifacts do not contain and that the paper never estimates. So the head-to-head S5 promises cannot be reported from what exists. Two honest options: (a) estimate the mapping and report it as an assumption-laden conversion, or (b) remove the promise from S5. The plan forbade (b) as an escape hatch, so (a) is the remaining work - and it is a new modelling step, not a scoring job as plan v3 assumed.
plan_correction: Plan v3 P0.7 asserted this was 'a scoring/reporting job, not a new experiment' because code/joint_budget.py exists. That was wrong: the script computes each arm in its own units and never converts. The conversion is the missing work.
